description: This file defines a custom Swing text field component, JTextFieldWithWidth, which allows setting a specific preferred width.

classes.name: JTextFieldWithWidth
classes.description: A subclass of JTextField that allows specifying a custom preferred width.

methods.name: JTextFieldWithWidth(int width)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a JTextFieldWithWidth with empty text and specified width.

methods.name: JTextFieldWithWidth()
methods.description: Constructor that creates a JTextFieldWithWidth with default width of 200.

methods.name: JTextFieldWithWidth(String text)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a JTextFieldWithWidth with specified text and default width of 200.

methods.name: JTextFieldWithWidth(String text, int width)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a JTextFieldWithWidth with specified text and width.

methods.name: getPreferredSize()
methods.description: Overrides the default to return a Dimension with the custom width.
